children: ECO SCIENCE SOLUTIONS, INC. reported results for 2026 showing initial revenue as the company moves from development to commercial operations, with total revenue of $1.95K and a net loss of ($256.31K); diluted loss per share was ($0.01) for the period. This marks the first period with measurable revenue following prior-year inactivity.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “loss per common share - basic and diluted”.
Revenue Growth: Limited commercialization began; net revenue of $2,205 for the six-month period versus $0 in the prior period, indicating initial traction.
Channel Shift: Launched Herbo Pay transaction processing, moving from development-only work to live payments and platform services.
Product Momentum: Continued development of Herbo ERP and eXPO platforms; eXPO has been placed in service and amortization commenced.
Operational Milestone: Began recognizing transaction and hosting fees and recording customer deposits as prefunded balances for future use.
Go-to-Market: Ongoing efforts to onboard users, build customer infrastructure, provide training and engage regulators to drive platform adoption.
